name: Mitsubishi Corporation
summary: Mitsubishi Corporation engages in the global environment and energy, material solutions, metal resources, social infrastructure, mobility, food industry, SLC, and power solutions businesses in Japan and internationally. The Global Environmental Energy segment engages in the development and production of natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG), LPG, and petroleum products; and development of energy businesses. The Material Solutions segment is involved in sales transactions; and business investment and business development in material-related fields, including petrochemicals, basic chemicals, functional materials, carbon/ceramics, and steel products.
